info.name: Kipa - Support Chat & Admin Auth API
info.description:
Support Chat System, Support Staff Management, and Admin Authentication for Kipa Platform

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/v1

## Overview
User-to-admin/support staff chat system plus admin signup flow.

## Support Staff Role
Admins can designate users as support staff with configurable permissions:
- `reply_chats` - Reply to support conversations
- `view_disputes` - View dispute details in conversations
- `resolve_chats` - Mark conversations as resolved
- `message_users` - Initiate chat with any user

Support staff can access support chat endpoints based on their permissions. Admins always have full access.

## Support Chat Features
- **Multiple conversations per user** - Users can have multiple open conversations (general + dispute-linked)
- **Dispute integration** - When a dispute is opened, a dedicated support chat is auto-created
- **Any admin/support staff can reply** - No assignment required (with permission)
- **Push notifications** - Users notified on replies
- **Telegram notifications** - Admins notified via Telegram when users message
- **Media support** - Text and image messages supported
- **Auto-close** - Dispute chats auto-close when dispute is resolved

## User Support Flow
1. **General Chat:** `GET /support` to open/resume general conversation
2. **Multiple Chats:** `GET /support/conversations` to list all conversations (general + disputes)
3. **Specific Chat:** `GET /support/conversations/:id` to get a specific conversation
4. User sends messages via `POST /support/messages` (general) or `POST /support/conversations/:id/messages` (specific)
5. User fetches history via `GET /support/messages` or `GET /support/conversations/:id/messages`
6. User marks messages read via `POST /support/messages/read` or `POST /support/conversations/:id/read`

## Admin/Support Staff Flow
1. List conversations via `GET /admin/support/conversations` (all support staff)
2. View conversation details via `GET /admin/support/conversations/:id` (requires view_disputes)
3. Reply via `POST /admin/support/conversations/:id/messages` (requires reply_chats)
4. Message any user directly via `POST /admin/support/users/:user_id/messages` (requires message_users)
5. Resolve conversation via `POST /admin/support/conversations/:id/resolve` (requires resolve_chats)

## Admin Signup Flow
1. Send OTP via `POST /auth/otp/send` (same as regular users)
2. Verify with admin secret via `POST /auth/admin/otp/verify`
3. User becomes admin (is_admin: true)

## Variables
- `base_url`: API base URL (e.g., http://localhost:8080)
- `access_token`: JWT access token
- `conversation_id`: Support conversation ID
- `user_id`: Target user ID (for admin messaging)
- `admin_secret`: Server-configured admin signup secret
- `verification_id`: OTP verification ID
- `staff_user_id`: User ID for support staff management

item.name: User - Support Chat (Legacy)
item.description: Legacy endpoints for general support chat (single conversation). Use these for simple support without dispute context.

request.description:
Get existing open general conversation or create a new one.

This endpoint is for general support only (no dispute context). For dispute-linked conversations, those are auto-created when a dispute is opened.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "conversation": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "user_id": "uuid",
    "user_name": "John Doe",
    "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
    "status": "open",
    "dispute_id": null,
    "last_message_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
    "unread_count": 2,
    "created_at": "2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"
  },
  "active_disputes": null
}
```

**Notes:**
- Returns only general support conversation (no dispute_id)
- Use `GET /support/conversations` to see all conversations including dispute chats

Send a message in the user's open general support conversation.

**Request Body:**
- `content` (required): Message text (1-2000 characters)
- `media_url` (optional): URL to uploaded media
- `media_type` (optional): `text` or `image` (default: text)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "conversation_id": "uuid",
  "sender_id": "uuid",
  "sender_name": "John Doe",
  "is_admin": false,
  "content": "Hello, I need help with my order",
  "media_url": null,
  "media_type": "text",
  "status": "sent",
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
  "read_at": null
}
```

**Notes:**
- Admins are notified via Telegram
- User must have an open conversation first (call GET /support)

Send an image message. Upload the image first using the upload endpoint, then include the URL here.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "content": "Here is a screenshot of the issue",
  "media_url": "https://s3.../image.jpg",
  "media_type": "image"
}
```

query.description: Number of messages to return (default: 50, max: 100)
Fetch messages before this message ID (for pagination)

request.description:
Get message history for the user's open general conversation.

**Query Parameters:**
- `limit` (optional): Number of messages (default: 50, max: 100)
- `before_id` (optional): Message ID for pagination (fetch older messages)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "conversation_id": "uuid",
      "sender_id": "uuid",
      "sender_name": "Support",
      "is_admin": true,
      "content": "How can I help you today?",
      "media_url": null,
      "media_type": "text",
      "status": "read",
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
      "read_at": "2025-01-15T10:06:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Notes:**
- Messages are returned in descending order (newest first)
- Use `before_id` to load older messages

Mark all admin messages as read in the user's general conversation.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Only marks admin messages as read (not user's own messages)
- Call this when user opens the chat screen

item.name: User - Multi-Conversation Support
item.description:
Endpoints for managing multiple support conversations (general + dispute-linked).

Users can have:
- One general support conversation
- Multiple dispute-linked conversations (auto-created when disputes are opened)

request.description:
List all support conversations for the user.

Includes both general support and dispute-linked conversations.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "conversations": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "user_id": "uuid",
      "user_name": "John Doe",
      "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
      "status": "open",
      "dispute_id": null,
      "dispute": null,
      "last_message_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
      "unread_count": 2,
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "user_id": "uuid",
      "user_name": "John Doe",
      "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
      "status": "open",
      "dispute_id": "uuid",
      "dispute": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "reason": "Item not as described",
        "status": "open",
        "item_name": "iPhone 15 Pro",
        "item_amount": 50000
      },
      "last_message_at": "2025-01-14T10:00:00Z",
      "unread_count": 1,
      "created_at": "2025-01-14T09:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Notes:**
- Sorted by last_message_at descending
- `dispute_id` is null for general support conversations
- `dispute` contains summary info for dispute-linked conversations

Get a specific conversation by ID.

For dispute-linked conversations, includes full dispute details with escrow and payment request info.

**Response (General Chat):**
```json
{
  "conversation": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "user_id": "uuid",

    "unread_count": 2,
    "created_at": "2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"
  },
  "active_disputes": null
}
```

**Response (Dispute Chat):**
```json
{
  "conversation": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "user_id": "uuid",
    "user_name": "John Doe",
    "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
    "status": "open",
    "dispute_id": "uuid",
    "dispute": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "reason": "Item not as described",
      "status": "open",
      "item_name": "iPhone 15 Pro",
      "item_amount": 50000
    },
    "last_message_at": "2025-01-14T10:00:00Z",
    "unread_count": 1,
    "created_at": "2025-01-14T09:00:00Z"
  },
  "active_disputes": [
    {
      "dispute": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "escrow_id": "uuid",
        "opened_by": "uuid",
        "reason": "Item not as described",
        "evidence": ["https://s3.../image1.jpg"],
        "status": "open",
        "outcome": "pending"
      },
      "escrow": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "item_amount": 50000,
        "status": "disputed"
```

Use this for dispute-linked conversations or when you have multiple conversations.

**Request Body:**

item.name: Admin - Support Staff Management
item.description:
Admin-only endpoints for managing support staff.

Admins can add users as support staff with configurable permissions. Support staff can then access support chat endpoints based on their permissions.

**Permissions:**
- `reply_chats` - Reply to support conversations
- `view_disputes` - View dispute details in conversations
- `resolve_chats` - Mark conversations as resolved
- `message_users` - Initiate chat with any user

**Requires:** Admin role (`is_admin: true`)

request.description:
Add a user as support staff with specified permissions.

**Request Body:**
- `user_id` (required): UUID of the user to add as support staff
- `can_reply_chats` (optional): Allow replying to conversations (default: true)
- `can_view_disputes` (optional): Allow viewing dispute details (default: false)
- `can_resolve_chats` (optional): Allow resolving conversations (default: false)
- `can_message_users` (optional): Allow initiating chats with users (default: false)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "user_id": "uuid",
  "user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
  },
  "added_by": "uuid",
  "added_by_user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "first_name": "Admin",
    "last_name": "User",
    "phone_number": "+2348098765432"
  },
  "can_reply_chats": true,
  "can_view_disputes": true,
  "can_resolve_chats": false,
  "can_message_users": false,
  "permissions": ["reply_chats", "view_disputes"],
  "is_active": true,
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `400`: Invalid user ID or user already is support staff
- `404`: User not found
- `403`: Not admin

query.description: Filter to only active support staff (true/false)

**Path Parameters:**

**Response:**

```json
{
```

Update support staff permissions or active status.

All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.

**Path Parameters:**
- `user_id`: UUID of the support staff member

**Request Body (all optional):**
- `can_reply_chats`: Allow replying to conversations
- `can_view_disputes`: Allow viewing dispute details
- `can_resolve_chats`: Allow resolving conversations
- `can_message_users`: Allow initiating chats with users
- `is_active`: Enable/disable support staff access

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "user_id": "uuid",
  "user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
  },
  "added_by": "uuid",
  "added_by_user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "first_name": "Admin",
    "last_name": "User",
    "phone_number": "+2348098765432"
  },
  "can_reply_chats": true,
  "can_view_disputes": true,
  "can_resolve_chats": true,
  "can_message_users": true,
  "permissions": ["reply_chats", "view_disputes", "resolve_chats", "message_users"],
  "is_active": true,
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2025-01-15T11:00:00Z"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Set `is_active: false` to temporarily disable support staff access without removing them

Remove a user from support staff.

This permanently removes their support staff status. Use PUT with `is_active: false` if you want to temporarily disable instead.

**Path Parameters:**
- `user_id`: UUID of the support staff member to remove

**Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "support staff removed successfully"
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `404`: Support staff not found

item.name: Admin/Support - Chat Operations
item.description:
Endpoints for managing support conversations.

Accessible by **admins** (full access) or **support staff** (based on permissions).

**Permission Requirements:**
- List conversations, Get messages: All support staff
- Get conversation details: Requires `view_disputes` permission
- Send reply, Mark read: Requires `reply_chats` permission
- Resolve conversation: Requires `resolve_chats` permission
- Message any user: Requires `message_users` permission

**Notifications:**
- Telegram: Admins receive Telegram notifications when users send messages
- Configure via env vars: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`, `TELEGRAM_ENABLED`

query.description: Filter by status: open, resolved, closed

request.description:
List all support conversations.

**Access:** Admin or any support staff

Includes both general and dispute-linked conversations.

**Query Parameters:**
- `status` (optional): Filter by status (`open`, `resolved`, `closed`)
- `limit` (optional): Number of results (default: 50)
- `offset` (optional): Pagination offset (default: 0)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "conversations": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "user_id": "uuid",
      "user_name": "John Doe",
      "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
      "status": "open",
      "dispute_id": "uuid",
      "dispute": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "reason": "Item not as described",
        "status": "open",
        "item_name": "iPhone 15 Pro",
        "item_amount": 50000
      },
      "last_message_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
      "unread_count": 3,
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "user_id": "uuid",
      "user_name": "Jane Smith",
      "user_phone": "+2348098765432",
      "status": "open",
      "dispute_id": null,
      "dispute": null,
      "last_message_at": "2025-01-15T09:30:00Z",
      "unread_count": 1,
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T08:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 15
}
```

**Notes:**
- Sorted by last_message_at descending
- `unread_count` shows user messages not read by admin
- `dispute` is populated for dispute-linked conversations

Send a reply to a user's conversation.

**Access:** Admin or support staff with `reply_chats` permission

**Request Body:**
- `content` (required): Message text (1-2000 characters)
- `media_url` (optional): URL to uploaded media
- `media_type` (optional): `text` or `image`

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "conversation_id": "uuid",
  "sender_id": "uuid",
  "sender_name": "Admin Name",
  "is_admin": true,

  "media_url": null,
  "media_type": "text",
  "status": "sent",
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
  "read_at": null
}
```

**Notes:**
- User receives push notification
- Any admin/support staff with permission can reply

**Error Responses:**
- `403`: Insufficient permission (requires reply_chats)

Send a message to any user directly.

**Access:** Admin or support staff with `message_users` permission

Useful for reaching out to sellers when a buyer opens a dispute, or proactively contacting users.

If the user has an open general support conversation, the message is added there. Otherwise, a new conversation is created.

**Request Body:**
- `content` (required): Message text (1-2000 characters)
- `media_url` (optional): URL to uploaded media
- `media_type` (optional): `text` or `image`

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "conversation_id": "uuid",
  "sender_id": "uuid",
  "sender_name": "Admin Name",
  "is_admin": true,
  "content": "Hi, we noticed a dispute was opened against you...",
  "media_url": null,
  "media_type": "text",
  "status": "sent",
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
  "read_at": null
}
```

**Notes:**
- User receives push notification
- Creates a new general conversation if user has no open one
- Use this to reach sellers in buyer-opened disputes

**Error Responses:**
- `403`: Insufficient permission (requires message_users)

Mark all user messages as read in a conversation.

**Access:** Admin or support staff with `reply_chats` permission

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Only marks user messages as read (not admin messages)
- Call this when opening the conversation

**Error Responses:**
- `403`: Insufficient permission (requires reply_chats)

Mark a conversation as resolved.

**Access:** Admin or support staff with `resolve_chats` permission

Once resolved, the conversation appears with "resolved" status in the user's conversation list.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "conversation resolved successfully"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Changes status from `open` to `resolved`
- User can start a new general conversation if needed
- Dispute-linked conversations are auto-resolved when the dispute is resolved

**Error Responses:**
- `403`: Insufficient permission (requires resolve_chats)

item.name: Admin Auth
item.description:
Admin signup flow. Uses same OTP send endpoint as regular users, but verifies with admin secret.

**Flow:**
1. Send OTP to phone number (same as regular users)
2. Verify OTP with admin secret - creates/upgrades user to admin

**Configuration:**
Server must have `server.admin_signup_secret` configured.

request.description:
Send OTP to phone number. Same endpoint as regular users.

**Request Body:**
- `phone_number` (required): Phone in E.164 format (e.g., +2348012345678)
- `device_id` (required): Unique device identifier (8-128 chars)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "verification_id": "uuid",
    "idempotency_key": "string",
    "expires_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
    "retry_after_seconds": 60
  }
}
```

Verify OTP with admin secret. Creates new admin user or upgrades existing user to admin.

**Request Body:**
- `phone_number` (required): Phone in E.164 format
- `verification_id` (required): From send OTP response
- `otp_code` (required): 6-digit OTP
- `device_id` (required): Same device ID from send OTP
- `idempotency_key` (required): Unique key (32-64 chars)
- `admin_secret` (required): Server-configured admin secret (min 16 chars)

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ...",
    "refresh_token": "eyJ...",
    "expires_in": 900,
    "token_type": "Bearer",
    "user": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "phone_number": "+2348012345678",
      "phone_verified": true,
      "is_admin": true,
      "is_seller": false,
      "is_buyer": false,
      "is_rider": false,
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z"
    },
    "is_new_user": true
  }
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `401 INVALID_ADMIN_SECRET`: Wrong admin secret
- `403 ADMIN_SIGNUP_NOT_ALLOWED`: Admin signup not configured on server
- `401 INVALID_OTP`: Wrong OTP code
- `401 OTP_EXPIRED`: OTP has expired
